chunks: And do not grieve you those who rush into disbelief. Indeed, they will not harm God at all. God intends that He not give them any share in the Hereafter, and for them is a great punishment.
ai.seo_question: Why do those who rush into disbelief not harm God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of 'Ghubb' (satisfaction) for the Prophet, assuring him that the haste of disbelieers in rejecting truth does not diminish God's sovereignty. It underscores the divine decree that their rapid rejection precludes any share in the Hereafter, serving as a comfort to the faithful amidst early Islamic trials.
